annotations.rationale: The route restriction is concretely inspectable through named guide parts, holes, base starts, and payload anchors, but the record explicitly gives UNKNOWN for both expected and weakening observations and states no prospective quantitative acceptance or refutation threshold.

The record supplies an exact git locator, quantitative mathematical outputs, and six finite-nonlinear cases with content-addressed artifact identifiers, loads, response measures, validity flags, and geometry status.

The method specifies the physical routing, guide-hole coordinates, three-segment 36-cell discretization, section geometry, material and viscosity parameters, and nonlinear checks at three positions under both force signs. Its scope is limited because only checked poses and qualified local minima are reported, and the s=0.7 cases are geometrically illegal; solver identity and convergence or mesh-sensitivity evidence are not supplied.

The node documents a proposed configuration and its evaluation but does not identify prior evidence that caused a change in the design, model, or testing plan. No adaptation can be inferred from the P2 label alone.

A fully specified routing and physical model was proposed, execution is explicitly recorded as generated and evaluated, and quantitative mathematical and finite-nonlinear evaluations are attached. The record does not establish that evaluation was performed independently of the proposing process or document a subsequent action taken in response to the illegal s=0.7 cases.
Although both s=0.7 nonlinear cases are marked invalid with illegal geometry, the record does not document abandonment of this candidate, route, operating point, or method on that basis.

The claimed 72-cell mesh, eight physical guides and connectors, named-hole routing, same-base starts, and payload anchors are concretely auditable, and comparison with a 36-cell screen is measurable. However, expected and weakening observations are explicitly UNKNOWN, with no prospective discrepancy threshold or observation that would refute the proposed configuration.

The node includes an exact git locator, quantitative mathematical-screen results, and six finite-nonlinear evaluations with explicit load cases, response values, validity and geometry findings, and unique content-addressed JSON artifact references.

The method concretely defines a frozen 72-cell physical mesh, nine segment properties, circular sections, material and damping parameters, eight guide plates with owned holes, and bilateral nonlinear load checks at three positions, alongside a 36-cell mathematical screen. All reported checked poses are legal, but solver identity, convergence criteria, connector modeling details, and a formal mesh-discrepancy criterion are absent, limiting assessment of fidelity and assumptions.

The use of a 72-cell physical mesh and comparison against a 36-cell screen could represent a methodological change, but the node cites no prior observation that motivated it and documents no evidence-driven modification after evaluation. Adaptation cannot be inferred from the P3 label.

The proposed 72-cell configuration is fully parameterized, the execution status confirms generation and evaluation, and mathematical and nonlinear outputs are reported with artifact locators. No independent evaluator or independent replication is identified, and no later design or research action tied to the resulting evidence is documented.

No candidate, route, model, or operating condition is explicitly rejected or abandoned. The reported nonlinear cases are all valid and legal at the checked poses, and the record contains no evidence-based rejection decision.
